# musicguessr

> Free, open-source browser companion for the Hitster music card game. Scan a Hitster card's QR code and the song plays on YouTube, Spotify, or Apple Music — Spotify is not required.

## What is musicguessr?

musicguessr lets players scan the QR code on a Hitster card and instantly play that song in their browser, using whichever music service they have:

- **YouTube** — always available, no account required
- **Spotify** — Web Playback SDK in the browser (requires Premium); on iPhone/iPad playback is handed to the Spotify app via Spotify Connect
- **Apple Music** — MusicKit JS (requires a subscription)

The game: players listen to a song and guess the year it was released, placing cards on a timeline in chronological order. The player with the most correctly placed cards wins.

## Key features

- QR code scanner for every Hitster edition whose cards carry a QR code
- Multi-provider playback: YouTube, Spotify, Apple Music
- Custom deck creator: build a Hitster-style music quiz from YouTube videos, or import a whole YouTube playlist
- Shareable decks via link or QR code; decks expire after a chosen period (1 week to 1 year)
- Installable Progressive Web App
- No user accounts; game state stays in the browser
- Available in English, Polish, German and Dutch

## Technical details

- Frontend: Angular 21 PWA (standalone components, signals), statically prerendered pages
- Backend: Go 1.27 REST API, standard library only
- Deck storage: local filesystem or S3-compatible object storage
- Open source, MIT license
- Not affiliated with Jumbo, Hitster, Spotify, Apple, or YouTube
